crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A small, circular, high-contrast red patch located on the posterior midline of the nape.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Diffuse boundary where dark charcoal crown feathers transition into lighter grey-brown mantle feathers without a sharp linear interface.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, high-contrast white patch on the rump and lower back area.
